title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Acts 5: Ananias and Sapphira, the apostles freed from prison, and Gamaliel's advice to the council.

questions.text: What did Ananias do with the price of the possession he sold?
questions.explanation: He kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, and brought a certain part to the apostles' feet.

answers.text: He kept back part of the price
He gave all of it to the apostles
He returned the field to its owner
He gave it to the priests

questions.text: What did Peter say Satan had filled Ananias' heart to do?
questions.explanation: Peter asked why Satan had filled his heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land.

answers.text: To lie to the Holy Spirit

questions.text: What happened to Ananias when he heard these words?
questions.explanation: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died, and great fear came on all who heard these things.

questions.text: How long after this did his wife come in?
questions.explanation: About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.

questions.text: Why did they lay the sick on cots and mattresses in the streets?
questions.explanation: They did it so that as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

answers.text: So that Peter's shadow might overshadow them
So that the priests would see them
So that they could hear the teaching
So that the apostles could count them

questions.text: Who opened the prison doors by night and brought the apostles out?
questions.explanation: An angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, brought them out, and told them to speak in the temple.

answers.text: The young men of the assembly

questions.text: What did the officers report when they went to the prison?
questions.explanation: They reported that they found the prison shut and locked with the guards standing before the doors, but no one inside.

answers.text: That the apostles refused to come
That the doors had been broken open
That the guards had fled in the night
That the prison was locked but empty

questions.text: How did Peter and the apostles answer the high priest?
questions.explanation: Peter and the apostles answered, "We must obey God rather than men."

answers.text: "We must obey God rather than men."
"We will speak no more in this name."

questions.text: Who stood up in the council and advised them to leave these men alone?
questions.explanation: A Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law honored by all the people, stood up in the council and spoke.

questions.text: Why did the apostles rejoice as they left the council?
questions.explanation: They departed rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus' name.

answers.text: Because the council had believed them
Because they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor
Because the people had defended them
